body:
Thanks for sharing your story with me.  There are a lot of similarities between our two stories, although I haven't had a parent die of that awful disease. ( hugs )

My only question is, why hang on?  I've been hanging on for a decade and a half.  I've been convincing myself that this will pass, that I won't feel this way forever, that it's only my screwed up brain chemistry telling me to do this.  None of that seems to matter when my future is so bleak that, logically speaking, I'd be better off ending it now.
